maria_lopez: Hey team — Hina Patel (candidate) is coming onsite next Tue and a few access/ops items popped up. She arrives ~09:00 via BART and prefers an accessible entrance. Can we confirm who owns each piece? :pray:

facilities_bot: Accessible entrance confirmed — Door A (ramp) will be unlocked at 08:45. Reserved Visitor Parking stall #P12 for 09:00–16:00. Visitor badge code: 4321-ON-OPS.

people_ops_bot: Interpreter (ASL) tentatively booked 09:15–12:30. Transit stipend of $25 approved; will be issued via ExpenseOps within 48hrs. Dietary: vegetarian + gluten-free lunch ordered and labeled.

recruiting_ops: Quick ask — can you paste the ETA and phone again so security can pre-register? Also need confirmation whether remote panelists should be sent a Zoom link or a room will be set up for them.

maria_lopez: ETA 09:00, phone +1-415-555-0198 (same as Samir). Please use Zoom links for remote panelists. I'll drop a brief day-of itinerary below for front desk and the dev room operator:

```
Visit day timeline (Tue):

09:00  Candidate arrives, front desk uses badge 4321-ON-OPS
09:15  Welcome + ASL interpreter intro (Conf B)
09:30  Panel 1 (Conf B) — in-person
11:30  Quiet room for take-home (Room Q3)
```

maria_lopez: Laptop spec = Ubuntu 22.04 image, Docker, git, Node 18. Please provision as loaner and label "Hina-loaner".

devon_h: Perfect. I'll add the Zoom link to the calendar and ping the remote panelists. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
